name: vitals-site
description: Website for Vitals for Mac — React + Vite, prerendered to static HTML, on Cloudflare Pages. functions/api holds the license server (Pages Functions + D1).

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy
